name: Nyatorase: Shared Passions
source:
Nyatorase is an 18+ netorase visual novel, wherein you confess to your lovely goth catgirl wife that you have a fetish for watching her have sex with other men. This is a story of how you and your wife fall further into depravity, egged on by your mutual friends.

[From [url=https://sadgecatte.itch.io/nyatorase-shared-passions]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Nyatorase是一部18岁以上的netorase视觉小说，在其中，你向你可爱的哥特猫女郎妻子坦白，你有一种迷恋，喜欢看她与其他男人发生性关系。这是一个关于你和你的妻子如何在共同朋友的怂恿下进一步堕落的故事。

[来自[url=https://sadgecatte.itch.io/nyatorase-shared-passions]Itch.io[/url]]
